messages:
rachel_prod: quick follow-up from the postmortem 17 we observed a repeating KV-eviction signature across multiple incidents. want to convert remediation into a small, maintainable test surface & clear ownership. proposal: (1) CI fault-inject regression, (2) nightly tenant-blast load, (3) incident-driven promptset + eval gating, (4) a recurrence-detection alert and quarterly chaos drill. owners and rough ETAs below.
omar_sre: +1. CI step must be non-flaky and <8m. I can help build the injector and the recurrence detector. will add owner-rotation metadata so oncall knows who to page next.
li_ml: I can own the promptset and eval harness. plan: 10 targeted prompts reproducing long-context churn + short-burst contention. wire into nightly evals and add quality proxies. ETA: 2 sprints. filing RINF-8300.
peter_platform: Ill take CI fault-injection + nightly tenant-blast. plan: k6 -> k8s job, simulate 30 baseline tenants + 1 noisy tenant, ramp and sustain patterns. will include a cost cap and test-org creds. filing RINF-8301.
rachel_prod: please label tickets with "postmortem-eval" and link the postmortem. soft dates: CI PR by 2025-04-10, promptset in nightly by 2025-04-24, nightly integrated by 2025-05-01, recurrence alert + rotation by 2025-04-15.
omar_sre: recurrence alert spec: if eviction-rate >2x baseline twice in 72h, open a P0 candidate in incidents and notify oncall then the ticket owner. will add automated owner escalation in RINF-8302.
li_ml: promptset sketch (short descriptors) I'll add to RINF-8300 repo: P1: multi-turn 12k context with repeated backward refs; P2: burst of short 1-3 token queries from 100 concurrent clients hitting same convo id; P3: tenant-mix: 29 normal + 1 noisy tenant doing long updates. METRICS: eviction-rate, p95-latency, quality-proxy. Fail gates: eviction-rate delta >10% OR p95 >+20% OR quality proxy drop >5%.
peter_platform: nightly plan: ramp 10->200 users over 12m, sustain 90m, repeat x2. run in two modes: hosted-only and hosted+dedicated to validate routing fallbacks. infra checklist & cost estimate in RINF-8301.
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: "KV eviction coverage handoff" Thu 09:30 PT 1 link: https://calendar.redwood/eviction-handoff
rachel_prod: summary of action tickets: RINF-8300 (promptset+eval) RINF-8301 (CI+nightly) RINF-8302 (recurrence+alerts). owners: li_ml, peter_platform, omar_sre. please update tickets when PRs open. thanks all :thumbsup:
